results.name: Multi-file example resolves includes, macros, binary bytes and builds runnable NROM
Build is deterministic and preserves active project, assembly and emulator state
Original arbitrary binary bytes and CRLF source survive edits, JSON and ZIP export
Relative parent references resolve inside the root and path escapes are rejected
Duplicate normalized paths and invalid base64 are diagnosed before build
Missing includes and cycles report originating files and 1-based lines
Include and incbin expressions are refused explicitly, comments retain quoted semicolons
Unsupported dialects, foreign directives and Lua entry points do not translate silently
Assembly failures map to included source and restore project assembly state
NROM rejects mirrored aliases, missing vectors, RAM output and unbacked vectors
32 KiB layout and selected CHR bytes are respected; unsupported sizes fail
Expansion limits reject runaway inclusion before invoking the assembler
Exponential and recursive macro inputs fail before unbounded assembly work
Empty macro fan-out counts visits and emitted labels before calling the assembler
Source encoding errors preserve bytes and report a file rather than replacement text
